anchor:
- id: product-ui-artifact-critique
    prompt: "Continue after generating the first interface concept image."
    expected_skills: [product-ui-design]
    required_behaviors:
      - critique the generated artifact against the screen contract and art direction
      - identify missing core capabilities, unsupported inventions, hierarchy failures, and generic patterns
      - treat technically correct but generic output as incomplete
      - revise or regenerate when the current visual artifact does not satisfy the design gate
insertion:
- id: artifact-quality-generation-is-not-completion
    prompt: "Create the artifact and keep going until it is actually good enough for the stated objective."
    expected_skills: [artifact-quality]
    required_behaviors:
      - recover the live completion contract before judging the artifact
      - inspect the produced artifact through an available concrete observation path
      - do not equate successful generation or mutation with objective completion
      - classify material gaps before deciding whether another iteration is warranted
      - report unobserved quality as uncertain rather than pretending it was inspected

  - id: artifact-quality-bounded-iteration
    prompt: "Continue improving the generated artifact."
    expected_skills: [artifact-quality]
    required_behaviors:
      - preserve still-valid constraints and already-satisfied parts of the artifact
      - iterate only when a material gap and a concrete improvement hypothesis exist
      - revise the smallest material surface rather than restarting reflexively
      - reinspect evidence affected by the revision
      - stop when further changes would be subjective churn or speculative expansion

  - id: artifact-quality-domain-handoff
    prompt: "The UI concept image exists. Continue."
    expected_skills: [artifact-quality]
    optional_skills: [product-ui-design]
    required_behaviors:
      - use the domain specialist to define what counts as a good design artifact
      - use artifact-quality to govern inspect classify revise and reinspect convergence
      - preserve the distinction between observed product capability and proposed UX
      - do not load unrelated specialists merely because they could be useful
